prose: Spotatui, a revived Spotify terminal and desktop client, now works without Spotify's web API rate limits and supports other sources: YouTube, Subsonic/Navidrome, internet radio, local files, Qobuz and Apple Music on macOS, with Spotify Premium needed only for the Spotify source. Prebuilt binaries include the extra sources.
highlights: Works with YouTube, Subsonic, radio, local files, Qobuz, Apple Music.
Spotify Premium only needed for the Spotify source.
